0.0: Have you just returned from the forest? If so, then you must have noticed a tree that has turned red at the path to the Dragon Forest from the split road in the middle of the forest. I don't understand how that happened. It's like the tree has turned crimson red. I don't think other Halflingers have noticed this sudden change. Please relay this story to the Chief Tatamo.

no.0: The chief needs to know this...

1.0: You look like you have something to tell me. Take your time. Explain it to me slowly and in detail.

npc.0: Please relay the story I told you on The Red Tree to the #bchief. Tatamo.#k
